name: Alien-Trade Multi-Signal Score
description: Returns a structured multi-signal trading score for BSC-eligible tokens (ETH, CAKE, UNI, LINK, AAVE). Combines four orthogonal signals: S1 momentum (EMA cross + ROC), S2 derivatives (funding rate + open interest), S3 social sentiment, S4 on-chain exchange flow. Strategy is walk-forward validated on 2 years of daily data, optimized for Sortino - 2*maxDD (drawdown-first). Regime-gated: full size in trend, half in chop, 30% in high-vol, exit in crash.
author: alien-trade

lookback_bars.description: Recent daily bars for signal computation. Signals need at least 30; more bars give a more stable regime read.

regime_gate.description: Position size multiplier from regime: trend=1.0, chop=0.5, high_vol=0.3, crash=0.0.

momentum_score.description: S1: EMA cross + ROC signal, range [-1, 1]. Positive = bullish trend.

derivatives_score.description: S2: Funding rate + OI contrarian signal, range [-1, 1]. Positive = healthy funding, confirms trend.

sentiment_score.description: S3: Social sentiment rate-of-change, range [-1, 1]. 0 when social data unavailable.

flow_score.description: S4: On-chain exchange flow signal, range [-1, 1]. 0 when flow data unavailable.

verdict.description: Signal verdict based on entry/exit thresholds.

signal_strength.description: Absolute composite score bucket: strong (>=0.6), moderate (>=0.3), weak (<0.3).

bars_used.description: Number of daily bars used in signal computation.

error.description: Present only when computation failed. verdict will be 'hold', all scores 0.

examples.description: ETH signal score using last 60 daily bars

strategy_details.validation: walk-forward, 2-year daily OHLCV + Binance Futures funding/OI

signals.S2_derivatives: Funding rate contrarian + OI trend confirmation
signals.S3_sentiment: Social attention rate-of-change (requires CMC Pro data)
signals.S4_flow: Exchange net-outflow = accumulation proxy (requires CMC Pro data)

strategy_details.data_source: Binance public klines (OHLCV) + Binance Futures fapi (funding/OI)
strategy_details.note: S3/S4 scores are 0 in the current build. Full CMC Pro data will enable these signals, improving OOS Sortino.
